risk_note: RV2 (risk appeal_restore producer + commission read). D10-495 FU-APPEAL-RESTORE-PRICING (gate GATE-APPEAL-RESTORE-PRICING): a share whose FORFEIT voucher does not exist (port injected, answers null — e.g. R5 held while frozen, then ban and an R9 partial refund closed the obligation forfeited(banned) without a voucher) no longer rejects the whole revoked ban appeal into the dead letter; it stays in its sub-order's appeal_restore difference at amount 0 with resolution.shares item amount_source no_forfeit_voucher for the handler (admin ADMIN_RESTORE, B2-09ga) to recompute; a sub-order whose shares all lack a voucher is still registered once. Missing port (assembly error) still rejects. commission listBannedForfeitedShares now takes each share's latest event by event_seq first, then the window and forfeited(banned) (D10-481 ②). The frozen [B1-03z 没收金额端口] second case was changed to the new 口径 per D10-495 (first-class protected path; the other two frozen cases unchanged).
